title: RUSLE-Santa-LaBalsa: code and data for 'Formulation uncertainty, paraglacial terrain and mining legacies in water erosion of a deglaciating high-Andean basin'
description: Google Earth Engine notebook, permutation tests (basin, block displacement and elevation-slope stratified), DEM preprocessing, figure scripts, exported layers and compiled public monitoring data (ANA 2013, 2016; Cañón del Pato EIA 1997; Morera 2010) for the Santa River basin upstream of La Balsa, Peru.
